items.title: **r3 algebraic core re-opened**: `genericallyFree_quotient_prime_of_fibre_dim_le` fails the kernel build at 3 localized-module instance walls — proof text preserved in ledger `6c30537`.

commits.subject: Prove finite generation of affine sections of a finitely presented module sheaf (Stacks 01PC, finite-type half): for F of finite presentation and V an affine open inside a presenting-cover member, Γ(F,V) is a finite Γ(X,V)-module. The generating sections of the slice F|_{X_i} geometrize across the slice equivalence, pull back to Spec Γ(X,V) along the factorization of fromSpec, land on tilde Γ(F,V) by the 01I8 identification, and a finite generating epimorphism onto a tilde forces finite generation of the module because the tilde–Γ counit at a tilde is invertible and tilde is faithful (module_finite_of_tilde_genSections, module_finite_sections_of_quasicoherentData, exists_affine_finite_sections_nhds in Picard/QuotScheme.lean). Chart supply for Nitsure §4 generic flatness.
